storyboard: Hydrogen ions (H⁺) and hydroxide ions (OH⁻) move toward each other.
When they meet they combine to form a water molecule (H₂O).
The remaining sodium (Na⁺) and chloride (Cl⁻) ions pair up as table salt (NaCl).
Thus an acid and a base produce salt and water.
code:
from manim import *

class Explainer(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Title
        title = Text("Neutralization Reaction", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(FadeIn(title, shift=DOWN))
        self.wait(1)

        # Beat 1: H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O
        h = Circle(radius=1, color=RED).shift(LEFT * 3)
        h_label = Text("H⁺", font_size=40).move_to(h.get_center())
        h_group = VGroup(h, h_label)

        oh = Circle(radius=1, color=BLUE).shift(RIGHT * 3)
        oh_label = Text("OH⁻", font_size=40).move_to(oh.get_center())
        oh_group = VGroup(oh, oh_label)

        self.play(FadeIn(h_group), FadeIn(oh_group))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(h_group.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2), oh_group.animate.shift(LEFT * 2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(0.5)
        water = Circle(radius=1, color=GREEN)
        water_label = Text("H₂O", font_size=40).move_to(water.get_center())
        water_group = VGroup(water, water_label)
        self.play(Transform(VGroup(h_group, oh_group), water_group))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(water_group))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Beat 2: Na⁺ + Cl⁻ → NaCl
        na = Circle(radius=1, color=ORANGE).shift(LEFT * 3)
        na_label = Text("Na⁺", font_size=40).move_to(na.get_center())
        na_group = VGroup(na, na_label)

        cl = Circle(radius=1, color=TEAL).shift(RIGHT * 3)
        cl_label = Text("Cl⁻", font_size=40).move_to(cl.get_center())
        cl_group = VGroup(cl, cl_label)

        self.play(FadeIn(na_group), FadeIn(cl_group))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(na_group.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2), cl_group.animate.shift(LEFT * 2), run_time=2)
        self.wait(0.5)
        salt = Square(side_length=2, color=YELLOW)
        salt_label = Text("NaCl", font_size=40).move_to(salt.get_center())
        salt_group = VGroup(salt, salt_label)
        self.play(Transform(VGroup(na_group, cl_group), salt_group))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(FadeOut(salt_group))
        self.wait(0.5)

        # Takeaway
        takeaway = Text("Acid + Base → Salt + Water", font_size=36).to_edge(DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(takeaway, shift=UP))
        self.wait(2)

        # Clean up
        self.play(FadeOut(title), FadeOut(takeaway))
